name: capture
description: Self-hosted session recording and replay built on rrweb

scripts.build: esbuild src/recorder.js --bundle --minify --outfile=public/recorder.bundle.js && esbuild src/replay-app.js --bundle --minify --outfile=public/replay.bundle.js && esbuild src/snippet.js --minify --outfile=public/capture.js
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests
